title: Cloud Security: primary usage pricing
content:
Cloud Security primary usage pricing is governed by these handling clauses.

## Calculation and source basis

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in the Security category meter basis take priority.

For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Use the tier recorded for each source service interval.

Read primary unit rate and regional usage multipliers for primary usage.

Allocate included primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in interval start time then original source event reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month.

Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged.

Allocate committed primary quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines.

The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive commitment discount fractions; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary.

For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in primary-price selection priority: an approved negotiated rate when a negotiated-rate override is permitted, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from campaign-eligible channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard.

The negotiated rate replaces the primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.

Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive.

Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply the tax basis.

No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.

Record price component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity.

Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

For a discounted primary component, take the positive quantity remaining after its applied inclusion, multiply by its applicable unit rate and regional multiplier, and multiply by one less the selected discount fraction. This produces the unrounded service subtotal.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable charge action, authoritative system records must establish: For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a partial interval receive a portfolio discount before period close?**

Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Negotiated-rate arithmetic

Hypothetical inputs: a component has 10 billable workload-hours, an approved negotiated rate of USD 0.4 per workload-hour, and a regional multiplier of 1.5. Before rounding and tax, the service subtotal is USD 6. The negotiated rate replaces the standard rate and receives no further discount.
